A human wrote this file directly in an editor and did not follow the canonical key order
(`id, title, created_at, edited_at, reply_to, root, quote, trashed_at`). This is the fixture that
exercises the preserving-read path: parsing then re-serializing an unmodified note must reproduce
these exact bytes, key order and all, until the note is genuinely edited.
